import TemplateGrid from '../../../components/TemplateGrid.astro';

The templates install with the pack. To open one, use ComfyUI's template browser, pick a BytePlus workflow and press **Run**. Connect **Save Image** or **Save Video** if you want to keep a result.

Each template needs the keys of the services it uses. The facts box at the top of every template page lists them, and [API keys](../get-started/api-keys/) shows where to create each one. Workflows contain no keys: they come from **Settings → BytePlus**.

We ran every template live against the real BytePlus services on 2026-10-03, and each page shows the measured time. The one exception is Seed Voice Clone, which has not been run end to end yet. Running a template bills your BytePlus account, so check [billing and cost](../concepts/billing-and-cost/) first.

Templates show current models only. The Seedance 1.0 nodes and the older Seedream 4.5 and 4.0 options stay in the pack, but no template uses them.

One template per core service. Run these first to check that your key works.
